name: PiliPlus
subtitle: Flutter 开发的 BiliBili 第三方客户端 · A 3rd-party BiliBili client built with Flutter
description:
基于 Flutter 开发的 BiliBili（哔哩哔哩）第三方跨平台客户端，是 pilipala / PiliPalaX 的延续分支，支持 iOS、Android 与桌面端：视频、番剧、直播与互动视频播放，弹幕与高级弹幕，离线缓存与 WebDAV 备份，收藏夹、观看记录、动态、私信、多账号，以及 DLNA 投屏、SponsorBlock、倍速与手势控制等丰富播放选项。

An unofficial cross-platform BiliBili client built with Flutter (a continuation of pilipala / PiliPalaX), available on iOS, Android and desktop: video, bangumi, live and interactive video playback; danmaku; offline caching & WebDAV backup; favorites, watch history, dynamics, messages, multi-account; DLNA casting, SponsorBlock and rich playback controls.
